senses.gloss:
ज a. [जि-जन्-जु-वा ड] (At the end of comp.)
—1 Born from or in, produced or caused by, descended from, growing in,
 living or being at or in &c.; अत्रिनेत्रज, कुलज, जलज, क्षत्रियज,
 अण्डज, उद्भिज &c.
—2 Prepared from, made of.
—3 Belonging to, connected with, peculiar to.
—4 Swift.
—5 Victorious, conquering.

—1 A mother.
—2 A husbandʼs brotherʼs wife.
—3 A race, tribe. राघवʼs Nm. says. ‘जा स्त्रियां देववाहिन्यां योनिसागरवेलयोः’.
